hdmi_out.description: The HDMI-out jack: an HDMI transmitter (revela.boards.common.hdmi_tx, Digilent's rgb2dvi by default), driven by the design's raster, and its pins. What the raster transmits into: this board carries Digilent's rgb2dvi, and the cable is 8 bits a channel. A board with a different transmitter changes both.

out_khz.description: The raster's pixel clock, which picks rgb2dvi's serialiser range: set by the design.

max_pixel_khz.description: The fastest raster this jack is built for; the design's output mode is checked against it.

cable_data_bits.description: The cable's bits a pixel: 8 a channel.

serial_clock.description: 1: the transmitter's bit clock is given (serial_clk), made with the pixel clock by one clock manager, rather than by the transmitter's own PLL.

inputs.name: serial_clk
inputs.description: Five times pixel_clk, in phase with it.
